non_promotion_rule: Higher claim states require explicit gate satisfaction; cautionary prose cannot substitute for source custody, adjudication status, identity evidence, or privacy classification.

claim_states.name: queued/unreviewed
claim_states.meaning: Candidate lead exists but has not been admitted.

claim_states.name: source discovered
claim_states.meaning: A source has been found but not captured, pinned, or evaluated.

claim_states.name: source cited
claim_states.meaning: Source is cited with locator but not yet version-pinned or extracted.

claim_states.name: source pinned and extracted
claim_states.meaning: Version/custody recorded and fields extracted with extractor notes.

claim_states.name: corroborated or official-record-backed
claim_states.meaning: At least one independent source or official record supports the field, with conflicts noted.

claim_states.name: adjudication/outcome-backed
claim_states.meaning: A court, agency, arbitrator, POST body, settlement text, or disciplinary body produced a specific outcome.
claim_states.public_display: outcome-backed, never generalized beyond outcome text

claim_states.name: durable canonical with update route
claim_states.meaning: Record has stable source custody, conflict notes, privacy/display classification, correction route, and rollback rule.

tiers.name: official DOJ-linked court order proof atom
claim_scope_blocked: current status banner without freshness check

rev0018_overlay.rule: Evidence states and lifecycle states now pass through evidence atom and claim candidate grammar before any admitted/public claim.
